name: Kanto Contests (Alpha)
description: ALPHA / proof of concept -- playable but unfinished. Ruby/Sapphire-style Pokemon Contests in Kanto: enter the Celadon Contest Hall and appeal to the judge with your POKeMON's moves, scored by each move's contest category. One COOL contest so far; PokeSnacks, the other four types and ranks are still to come. Wins are recorded on the POKeMON, so Kanto Ribbons awards a Cool Ribbon.
